clue.text: Food fad is ultra silly

indicators.note: silly suggests the letters of these three words are jumbled foolishly into a new order

explanation.surface: A diet craze is dismissed as utterly ridiculous.
explanation.definitionFit: A mixed dish of chopped fruits is a familiar dessert, so it is a kind of food.

clue.text: Dull accommodation

explanation.definitionFit: Flat means dull or lacking life, and also an apartment to live in.

clue.text: Detectives to be involved in a French exploit? That's doubtful

parts.note: un is the French for a

indicators.note: to be involved in means the detectives go inside the exploit word

parts.note: a deed is a heroic act
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, British detectives

explanation.surface: Police helping with a French escapade is questionable.
explanation.definitionFit: Being undecided means uncertain about an outcome, so doubtful.

clue.text: This stunner could make you stare

indicators.note: the letters of the next word could be rearranged to make the answer

explanation.surface: A beauty could make you gawp.
explanation.definitionFit: A taser is an electric stun gun, so literally a stunner.

clue.text: A state that's perceptive, however you look at it

parts.note: NY is New York, a US state
wise means sagacious, perceptive

explanation.surface: A region that is shrewd from every angle.
explanation.definitionFit: Anywise is an old word meaning in any way or manner whatsoever.

clue.text: Special delivery offered by ace Irish doctor before work

parts.note: A is the card abbreviation for ace
op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: A top Irish physician hands over a package before getting to work.
explanation.definitionFit: Supplies dropped by parachute from an aircraft are a special kind of delivery.

clue.text: Security group must contribute to plan at once

indicators.note: each of these words gives some of its letters, so the answer sits within the run plan at once

explanation.surface: A defence alliance is told it has to help with a scheme immediately.
explanation.definitionFit: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization is a military alliance for collective security.

clue.text: Hosts expelling a thousand stars

indicators.note: expelling means the thousand letter is thrown out of the hosts word

parts.note: a host is an army, as in heavenly host
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: Party givers chuck out a thousand celebrities.
explanation.definitionFit: Aries is a constellation, a group of stars, the Ram.

clue.text: Passing a man in game when it's clear in front

indicators.note: in front means the clear word comes before the rest

parts.note: overt means open, plainly visible
the king is a piece, or man, in chess

explanation.surface: Overtaking a chess piece when the way ahead is open.
explanation.definitionFit: Overtaking another vehicle is passing it on the road.

clue.text: A name given to some French mountains

parts.note: des is the French word for some

explanation.surface: Peaks in France are given a label.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French mountains' looks like one phrase, but French belongs with 'some'; the range is in South America.
explanation.definitionFit: A long South American range, the example given is a chain of high peaks.

clue.text: Part of the country in which you'll find more than one riding

definitions.text: Part of the country in which you'll find more than one riding

parts.words: Part of the country in which you'll find more than one riding
parts.note: reads like a place with lots of horse riders, but a riding is also an old administrative division of a county

explanation.surface: A region where several people are on horseback.
explanation.walkthrough: The English county was divided into three Ridings (North, East and West), so it had more than one.
explanation.definitionFit: A large county in northern England historically split into three administrative ridings.

clue.text: Echo device that's more reliable

definitions.meaning: an instrument measuring depth by echoes, as used at sea

explanation.definitionFit: An echo sounder measures depth by sound; sounder is also comparative of sound, meaning more dependable.

clue.text: Postman, for instance, caught by 'ound

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
the dropped H marks a hound with its H missing, so the dog is a harrier with its H gone

explanation.surface: A postie gets nabbed by a dog, in a Cockney accent.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in 'ound tells you to drop the H from the hound word as well: a harrier is a hunting dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A postman carries the mail, so he is one example of someone who conveys things.

clue.text: Disturbance when university clique seizes power

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for power in physics
a set is a close social group

explanation.surface: Campus trouble breaks out when a faction grabs control.
explanation.definitionFit: An upset is a disturbance or disruption to normal order.

clue.text: Stifling Mama's kept in Carol

indicators.note: kept in means the parent word is held inside the carol word

parts.note: to carol is to sing
Mama is mother, the 's standing for is

explanation.surface: Mum is trapped inside a Christmas song.
explanation.definitionFit: Smothering means suffocating or stifling.

clue.text: This person needs appointment — one brought in to liaise

parts.note: the setter speaking of himself gives me

indicators.note: brought in means the numeral is placed inside the appointment word

parts.note: a date is an arranged meeting
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone needs a meeting where a go-between is brought in.
explanation.definitionFit: To act as a go-between between two parties is to liaise between them.

clue.text: Beer being given to right old rocker makes one alarmed

parts.note: ale is a kind of beer
a Ted, Teddy boy, was a 1950s rock and roll fan

explanation.surface: A drink given to an ageing rocker frightens someone.
explanation.walkthrough: Teddy boys were British youths of the 1950s known for Edwardian dress and rock and roll.
explanation.definitionFit: To be alerted is to be warned, put on guard, and so alarmed.

clue.text: Arabs may parade around this

parts.note: reads as people marching, but Arabs are also a breed of horse, led round before a race

explanation.surface: Arab people might march around a place.
explanation.walkthrough: Arab horses are walked round the enclosure at a racecourse before a race.
explanation.definitionFit: The enclosure where racehorses are paraded before a race.

clue.text: They're missing love on expeditions

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, O
missions are journeys with a purpose

explanation.surface: Explorers miss their partners while travelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Omissions are things left out, so they are missing.

clue.text: Smartest bird fails to get caught

indicators.note: to get caught means the failing word is trapped within the bird

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird
dies, as an engine does, means stops working

explanation.surface: The brightest bird gets away without being trapped.
explanation.definitionFit: Smartest in the sense of neatest, most trim, is a synonym for most orderly.

clue.text: One learning what's needed on golf course has to fall in

indicators.note: in means the fall word sits inside the golf word

parts.note: a tee is the peg a golfer drives from
rain is what falls from the sky

explanation.surface: A golf learner must cope when a downpour comes.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainee is a person being trained, so one learning.

clue.text: Skill I found in fellow who supposedly lives in another world?

definitions.text: who supposedly lives in another world?

indicators.note: found in means these letters are located inside the fellow word

parts.note: a fellow is a man
art is skill, as in the art of conversation

explanation.surface: An artistic flair is detected in a man thought to be from another planet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fellow' does double duty in the surface reading, giving MAN and completing the picture of a being from another world.
explanation.definitionFit: An inhabitant of Mars is the classic imagined being from another planet.

clue.text: With lines reduced by half, poet's producing wondrous things

indicators.note: lines are L's, and halving the pair leaves only one

parts.note: Andrew Marvell, the 17th-century poet, with 's

explanation.surface: A poet with half his verses cut still produces wonders.
explanation.walkthrough: Andrew Marvell's name has a pair of L's, and lines are L's in crosswords; 'reduced by half' turns the pair into a single L.
explanation.definitionFit: Marvels are wonders, astonishing things.

clue.text: Old lover, man or woman who has moved abroad?

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
Pat is a name used by both men and women

explanation.surface: A former partner has gone to live in another country.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for expatriate, someone living outside their native country.

clue.text: Young whelp, one learner who sits in class?

parts.note: a pup is a young dog
I is the Roman numeral for one
L is the learner driver plate

explanation.surface: A young dog learns in a classroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A pupil is a student who attends lessons in a classroom.

clue.text: A serial broadcast — such won't be for satellite TV

definitions.text: such won't be for satellite TV

indicators.note: broadcast in the sense of scattered widely, so the letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: A TV serial is transmitted, though not via satellite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' rearranges ASERIAL; terrestrial TV uses rooftop antennas, satellite TV uses a dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Rooftop antennas pick up terrestrial signals, while satellite reception needs a dish instead.

clue.text: Man called by God, a black sheep

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, on pencils
a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: A man chosen by God turns out to be the black sheep.
explanation.walkthrough: Abram was called by God to leave his home (Genesis 12), later renamed Abraham.
explanation.definitionFit: Abram is the Old Testament patriarch summoned by God to leave Ur.

clue.text: City in France producing camera component

definitions.meaning: the glass that focuses light in a camera

explanation.definitionFit: Lens is a city in the Pas-de-Calais and also the focusing glass on a camera.

clue.text: Troublemaker at start of exclusive social event is a hindrance

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous creature

indicators.note: start of picks out the opening letter of exclusive

parts.note: a dance is a social gathering

explanation.surface: A nuisance at the start of a private party gets in the way.
explanation.definitionFit: Impedance is something that obstructs or impedes, so a hindrance.

clue.text: Hour in river, a particular European river

indicators.note: in means the hour letter goes inside the river letters

parts.note: one means a particular individual, as in one Mr Smith

explanation.surface: A time spent on a river, one specific river in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rhone flows from Switzerland through France to the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Fourth in weightlifting — past it for first prize

indicators.note: fourth in picks the fourth letter of weightlifting

parts.note: past it means too old

explanation.surface: Coming fourth in weightlifting, an ageing athlete misses out on first place.
explanation.definitionFit: A gold medal is awarded for first place in competition.

clue.text: One lass about to be beset by troublesome people? We expect the worst

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded by the nuisances word

parts.note: pests are irritating people

indicators.note: about tells you to turn the girl and the numeral backwards

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a miss is a girl

explanation.surface: A girl is surrounded by nuisances, and the gloomy expect the worst.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns I and MISS round together; 'beset by' means the nuisances word wraps round the result, split as PE...STS.
explanation.definitionFit: People who always expect the worst outcome are by definition gloomy doom-mongers.
